title: NativeHumanActionResult
description: Reference-only observation of the original HUMAN AE. Component terminal status comes from original component-action audit after native/usage reconciliation. Native-origin platform resource permission actions use their exact permission-outcome audit; that outcome does not assert completion of a component's native sharing RPCs. Never infer a terminal result from HTTP acceptance.

inputJson.description: Original admitted canonical capability metadata input; exactly one input form, never a result body or a new execution authority.

nativeExecution.description: Original dispatched native-writer reference only. Neither existence nor RUNNING proves byte completion; no bearer is exposed by observation.

nativeExecutionAdmission.description: Transient same-request writer bearer for the exact original AE/EE. The native task must atomically claim the byte step before using it; never persisted or exposed to the browser.

expiresAt.description: RFC3339 admission expiry, preserved verbatim across language bindings and validated by the native writer before every byte step.

readAdmission.description: First native same-request read only. Never returned by idempotency observation or retried admission; the bearer is not persisted.
